name: TrussC v0.6.4
body:
_Changes since v0.6.2 (209 commits; includes the untagged v0.6.3)._

## ✨ Features
- **Timestamped frame queue for VideoGrabber** — `setFrameQueueSize()` + `getBufferFrames()` deliver **every** camera frame exactly once, each stamped on the capture thread (`GrabberFrame`: pixels + monotonic `timestampUs` in one struct). No lost frames when the camera outpaces the app loop; timestamps stay truthful even if the main loop stalls. For sensor-sync and measurement-grade capture. mac / win / linux, verified with real cameras on all three. New `videoGrabberFrameQueueExample`.
- **`extractFrame` / `extractKeyFrame`** — one-shot frame grabs from video: exact (frame-accurate) vs fast (nearest keyframe), static + instance forms, `getPath()`. Now implemented on Windows (Media Foundation) and Linux (FFmpeg) too.
- **Fixed-duration recording** — `VideoRecordSettings::duration` / `startRecording(path, seconds)`.
- **`drawBitmapString(Vec3)`** — billboards through the current camera.
- **GPU point-cloud rendering** — `Mesh(PrimitiveMode::Points)` + `PointStyle::Pixel` as a true GPU point primitive.
- **Version from git tags** — `getVersion()` now derives from tags (hardcoded 0.0.1 retired).
- **Reference pipeline overhaul** — prose lives in a TOML sidecar joined with the clang AST into `reference-data.json`; api-definition.yaml fully retired; **100% documentation coverage enforced in CI**; Lua bindings (tcxLua) now generated data-driven from reference-data (luagen).
- **tcxCurl** — `setFollowRedirects()` (default off) + native CA store on Windows.
- **Build-type flags** — `trusscli build/run --debug / --relwithdebinfo / --release`.
- **CI speedup** — ccache/sccache, docs-only skip, `ci-ok` aggregate gate.

## 🐛 Fixes
- Windows `extractFrame`/`extractKeyFrame` returned alpha=0 (fully transparent) frames.
- mac camera: requesting an unsupported frame rate could throw `NSException` (strict `CMTime` ranges); rate now clamps to the closest supported. fps is also part of format selection (720p@60 vs 720p@90).
- `trusscli build --release` actually produces a Release build (#153); `--web` configure during update.
- App's `src/` added as an include root for the normal build.
- Queued `Deliver::Main` calls dropped when the listener dies before drain.
- MSVC `/bigobj` by default; duplicate `push/popStyle` definitions merged (blend-aware kept).

## 🔧 Internal / DX
- Addon namespace refactor (`tcx`), FOR_AI corpus expansion (utility chunks, recording tools, frame-queue measurement Q&A), AI_AUTOMATION docs.

name: TrussC v0.6.2
body:
_Changes since v0.6.1 (108 commits)._

## ✨ Features
- **Native video recording (all platforms).** `VideoRecorder` for live screen capture + `VideoWriter` for offline export. macOS (AVFoundation), Windows (Media Foundation, HW→SW fallback, HEVC), Linux (GStreamer → H.264/mp4). Hardware encoder auto-preferred (NVENC) with probed fallback. New `videoRecExample` / `videoWriterExample`.
- **RenderTarget pipeline architecture.** 2D/3D pipeline selection is now routed through a `RenderTarget` that owns the pipelines — cleaner FBO/swapchain handling, pre-warmed.
- **Main-thread-safe Node tree.** `runOnMainThread` + `Event` `Deliver::Main` so off-thread code can safely mutate the tree.
- **Cross-platform network interface enumeration** (+ `networkInterfaceExample`).
- **`Path::toFillMesh()`** — reuse `drawFill`'s tessellation as a mesh.
- **`pushStyle`/`popStyle` now save & restore blend mode.**
- **`WindowSettings::setSwapInterval`.**
- **`trusscli build/run --warnings`** (opt-in `-Wall -Wextra` on app sources).
- **MCP hardening.** Dropped wildcard CORS; added `host`/`token` for safe external exposure; `registerDebuggerTools()` is now the explicit opt-in.
- **tcxBox2d Mod API.** `RigidBody2D` / `ColliderRenderer2D` + auto-updating `World`.
- **Reflection.** Unified `TC_VALUE` reflection; new `reflectExample` and `example-serialize`.

## 🐛 Fixes
- **StrokeMesh setters return `*this`** for method chaining (#148).
- **Screen/Multiply blend modes respect source alpha** (premultiplied) (#145).
- GPU buffer overflow fixes: sokol_gl per-layer re-append, PBR-inside-FBO O(N^2) growth, buffer-increase bug (#144).
- FBO-aware pipeline restores (Shader/FullscreenShader, 2D/3D, 3D drawn inside an FBO).
- `loadXml` / `Xml::save` resolve paths via `getDataPath`, matching `loadJson` (#129).
- EasyCam orthographic clip-space + quaternion fixes (#127, #133).
- Headless runner now drains the main-thread queue.
- `saveScreenshot` deferred until after `present()` so it captures the rendered frame.

## 🔧 Internal / DX
- `enableDebugger()` kept as a deprecated no-op shim.
- Examples include `<TrussC.h>` only; `tcBaseApp.h` marked internal.
- Extracted transform + mouse-global free functions out of `TrussC.h`.
- Windows `build_win.bat` installs `trusscli` to user PATH; `trusscli` addon dependency resolution.

## 🙏 Contributors
Thanks to **@icq4ever** for the EasyCam orthographic/quaternion fixes and the Windows global-path build improvement.

name: TrussC v0.6.1
body:
**TrussC becomes inspectable at runtime — the whole node tree is now readable, writable, and reflectable, with a bundled Unity-style inspector and an MCP bridge for AI agents.**

This release is mostly about *seeing and steering a running app*: a unified reflection system (`TC_REFLECT` / `TC_VALUE`), a bundled `tcxNodeInspector` (hierarchy + inspector + gizmo), and MCP tools that read and write the live scene graph as numbers — plus camera-aware picking, overlay input arbitration, an Android USB serial backend, IPv4 multicast, and a pile of input/graphics fixes.

## 🔍 Runtime inspection & reflection *(headline)*

- **Unified reflection** — one block, one macro:
  ```cpp
  TC_REFLECT(Enemy, Node) {          // (Self, DirectBases...)
      TC_VALUE(hp)                   // edited in place (enums auto-detected)
      TC_VALUE(alive, isAlive)       // getter only → read-only
      TC_VALUE(speed, getSpeed, setSpeed)  // via setter (invariants run)
  }
  ```
  Real braces (IDE folding / clang-format work), multi-base chaining, optional `TC_ENUM_LABELS` for human-readable enum combos.
- **JSON reflection backend** — serialize any reflected node/mod to JSON, with `applied` / `skipped` / `readOnly` / `unknown` reporting.
- **MCP node-tree tools** — `get_node_tree` (id / depth), `get_selected_node`, `select_node`, `set_node_members` (with a `mod` arg): read positions / rotations (degrees) / colors as numbers and write them live — no rebuild.
- **`tcxNodeInspector` is now a bundled addon** — runtime hierarchy tree + per-mod reflected inspector (enum combos, greyed read-only), a Unity-style move/rotate gizmo, and multi-select. The human-side UI over the same reflection + selection the MCP tools drive.
- **Node identity & selection API** — `name`, type name, instance id, child index; `getSelectedNode` / `setSelectedNode`.

## 🎥 Camera & input

- **Per-node camera context** — pick rays unproject through the camera each node was drawn under, so hit-testing and the gizmo line up even for z-moved 2D nodes and `EasyCam` scenes.
- **EasyCam** — `setAzimuth` / `setElevation` orbit-angle setters, configurable orbit / pan buttons, a required drag modifier, and it now *consumes* the gestures it claims (no more silent click-eating of node handlers).
- **Overlay input arbitration** — `consume` + `capture` on the event chain; an overlay (e.g. ImGui) marks input consumed and the node tree gates on it. Key dispatch is now deepest-first to match mouse.
- **`touchAsMouse` on by default** on all platforms; `Event<T>::notify` gained `consume`.

## 🎛 MCP automation

- **`mouse_press` / `mouse_release`** tools (so drags are injectable) + `mouse_move` optional-button fix.
- **`mouse_click` accepts modifier keys**; **ImGui MCP tools auto-register** when `TRUSSC_MCP=1`.
- Fixed `imgui_input` on macOS (select-all replace) and slider / drag numeric entry.

## ✍️ Graphics

- **`Path::drawFill`** — per-ring non-zero winding + self-intersection splitting, so converted/CFF fonts with self-crossing micro-loops fill correctly instead of rendering garbage. Added `Path::reverseWinding`.
- **`drawBitmapStringHighlight`** now always paints a solid background (was only an outline under an external `noFill()`) and no longer leaks color / fill mode.
- **`createCapsule`** primitive.
- Ortho screen volume centered on the camera; nodes render with their cached local matrix (no euler re-application); `Quaternion::toEuler` is now the exact inverse of `fromEuler`.

## 🔌 Android — USB serial *(new)*

- `tc::Serial` gained an **Android USB Host backend** for CDC-ACM devices (JNI + usbfs, **no Java sources**). Opening a device shows a one-time permission dialog; `setup()` returns false while pending and `isInitialized()` flips true asynchronously once granted (reconnect-loop safe). Hardware-verified on a XIAO nRF52840.

## 🌐 Networking

- **IPv4 multicast** for `UdpSocket` (join / leave / loopback / TTL) and **multicast in `tcxOsc`**, with a multicast/scoping test harness.

## 🍎 Platform

- **iOS Safari** — IBL bake (cube-face render targets) is auto-skipped on iOS web (it broke the swapchain); PBR falls back to direct lighting so scenes render instead of going black. Native / desktop-web / Android-web bake IBL normally.

## 🛠 Fixes & CI

- `tcxImGui` crash on window close (auto-teardown on exit + `sg_isvalid` guard); `tcxNodeInspector` gizmo handle flicker.
- `addMod` now calls `Mod::setup` through the base pointer (friendship isn't inherited).
- **Windows build** — `build_win.bat` forces the Ninja generator for VS2026, wipes stale `CMakeCache` on generator switch; CI runner pinned to `windows-2022` (VS2026 not yet supported) and gained a manual full-build `workflow_dispatch`.

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- **Reflection macros were unified.** `TC_FIELD` / `TC_PROPERTY` / `TC_PROPERTY_RO` / `TC_ENUM` / `TC_ENUM_PROPERTY` / `TC_REFLECT_END` and the `using Super = X;` convention are **removed** in favor of `TC_REFLECT(Self, Bases...) { TC_VALUE(...) }`. This only affects code written against the reflection API that shipped *after* v0.6.0 — **v0.6.0 had no reflection macros, so upgrading from v0.6.0 needs no migration.**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

name: TrussC v0.6.0
body:
**Sound and typography grew real depth, and TrussC gained two new subsystems — a device-independent depth-camera layer and bundled MIDI.**

This release overhauls the audio stack (streaming, real-time I/O, device hot‑plug), brings serious Japanese typography (vertical writing, wrapping, kinsoku, vector glyph paths), adds image/FBO mipmaps and path subpath fills — and introduces depth cameras and MIDI as first‑class parts of the framework.


## 🎵 Sound — a real audio engine

- **Streaming playback** — `Sound::loadStream(path, maxPolyphony)` streams long files from disk. `setSpeed` range is `[-10, 10]` (eager) / `[0, 10]` (stream).
- **Real-time audio I/O** — `AudioEngine::audioOut` / `audioIn` listeners for callback-based synthesis and processing (`audioSynthExample`).
- **AudioSettings + init** — `AudioEngine::init(AudioSettings{ .sampleRate, .channels, .bufferSize, .deviceName })`.
- **Device hot-plug** — `audioDeviceChanged` event rides through device swaps and sample-rate changes without dropping playback (`audioDeviceExample`).
- **Channel routing** — `MixMode` + `setChannelMap` + `setChannelGains` for multi-channel output.
- WAV / MP3 / FLAC all decode through one path; assorted fixes (3+ channel WAV stride, loop wrap, web fallback).

## 🈂️ Font — Japanese typography, for real

- **Vertical writing (tategaki)** — `Font::setWritingMode(WritingMode::VerticalRL)`, with Unicode vertical-form glyphs and upright fallback.
- **Line wrap + kinsoku** — `enableWrap` / `setMaxLineLength` / `setKinsoku(...)` (line-head/line-end prohibition), hanging punctuation, and tate-chu-yoko.
- **Vector glyph paths** — `Font::getStringPath(...)` / `getGlyphPath(codepoint)` return a `tc::Path` for stroke / fill / hit-test / animation — atlas-free.
- **Extensible bitmap font** — `registerGlyph()` for any codepoint, lazy atlas growth (ASCII-only stays ~0 KB).
- **System font lookup** — `systemFontPath(name)` / `listSystemFonts()` cross-platform (CoreText / DirectWrite / fontconfig); `TC_FONT_*` macros now resolve PostScript / family names.

## 🖼 Image / FBO / Path

- **Image / Pixels** — `halve` / `resize` / `crop` / `mirror`, gamma-correct box downscale and Catmull-Rom upscale, plus **mipmaps** (`allocate(..., mipmaps=true)`).
- **FBO mipmaps** — `Fbo::allocate(..., mipmaps=true)` rebuilds the mip chain on each `end()` (D3D11-safe via a scratch texture).
- **Path subpaths + fill** — a second `moveTo` starts a new subpath; `Path::drawFill()` triangulates with earcut and auto-detects holes (`O`, `日`, `あ`).

## 📷 Depth cameras — not tied to one device *(new subsystem)*

**Why.** In the openFrameworks world every depth camera gets its own addon (ofxKinect, ofxAzureKinect, ofxRealSense, …), so changing hardware means rewriting your code. TrussC puts an abstraction in front from day one. `tcxDepthCamera` defines a device-independent `DepthCamera` interface and a canonical `DepthFrame` (depth as `uint16 × depthScale`, color kept at native resolution). Concrete backends — e.g. [`tettou771/tcxAzureKinect`](https://github.com/tettou771/tcxAzureKinect), and `tcxOrbbec` to come — just plug in.

**What you can do.**
- Write only the part you care about — deprojection, point clouds, color mapping, and threading are done by the base:
  ```cpp
  cam->setThreaded(true);
  cam->update();
  if (cam->isFrameNew()) {
      Mesh cloud = cam->toMesh({ .colors = true });
      cloud.draw();
  }
  ```
- **Swap the backend and the rest of your app is unchanged** (`Orbbec` → `AzureKinect`, nothing else moves).
- Develop and run CI **without hardware** using `SyntheticDepthCamera` (a software-generated depth source).
- **Record and replay** depth streams with `tcxDepthRecord` (`.tcdc`) — capture on site, develop at your desk, replay in CI. Distortion-aware (Brown–Conrady) deprojection included.

## 🎹 tcxMidi — MIDI, bundled *(new)*

**Why.** Live shows and installations constantly need to talk to MIDI controllers and synths, yet hunting for an addon every time is friction. tcxMidi ships **bundled**, so MIDI is there out of the box. It's backed by libremidi (CoreMIDI / WinMM / ALSA / WebMIDI), fetched via CMake `FetchContent` (release tarball + SHA256 — **no `git` required**).

**What you can do.**
- Send and receive notes, control changes, program changes, pitch bend and sysex.
- Both an **event-callback** API (`in.onMessage.listen(...)`) and a **thread-safe polling** API.
- Devkits/demos already run for nanoKONTROL2, Launchkey Mini Mk3, and Launchpad Mini Mk3.
- Tested on macOS, Windows (in/out + sysex on real devices) and Web (Chrome, no sysex).

## ⏱ Core — off-thread timers & tidier mouse events

- **`callAfterAsync` / `callEveryAsync`** — unlike the frame-driven `callAfter` / `callEvery`, these fire from a shared background scheduler at precise times (no frame jitter, no drift) — for things like a sequencer playhead. Per-node cancel, in-flight-safe, `~Node` cleanup (native only).
- **Typed mouse event args** — `mouseMoved` → `MouseMoveEventArgs`, `mouseDragged` → `MouseDragEventArgs`, scroll → `ScrollEventArgs`, so each event carries only the fields that make sense for it. `MouseEventArgs` (press/release) no longer carries an always-zero `delta`. **Handler signatures are unchanged — source-compatible.**
- `clipboardPasted` event; `tc::compress` / `decompress` (LZ4).

## 🧩 Addons & CI

- **tcxMidi** is now an officially bundled addon.
- Bundled addons' `tests/` harnesses are built and run in CI; example tests run in the matrix.
- Shared CI (the `TrussC-org/ci-actions` reusable workflow) rolled out to the standalone addons (tcxArtnet, tcxPly, tcxGlitch, tcxIME, tcxOpenCV, tcxAruco, tcxMQTT, tcxSyphon, tcxPave, tcxTcv, tcxGPT, tcxBitmapStringKana, …).


## ⚠️ Breaking changes

There isn't much hard breakage this release — the biggest behavioral change to watch is the typed mouse events (still source-compatible).

1. **Audio default sample rate is now 48 kHz** (was 96 kHz). Code that assumed 96 kHz will be off in pitch/speed. Pass it explicitly: `AudioEngine::init(AudioSettings{ .sampleRate = 96000 })`.
2. **Deprecated sound `constexpr` aliases were removed** and `AudioEngine` constants became instance fields — old names no longer compile; move to the `AudioSettings` API.
3. **tcxLua: `io` and `package` are disabled by default.** Lua scripts that use `io.popen` / `package.loadlib` must opt in (`LuaModulePreferences{ .io = true, .package = true }`). See `addons/tcxLua/README.md`.

### Soft changes / deprecations (mostly transparent)
- **Serial**: `getDeviceList()` is deprecated (still works); `listDevices()` returns a `vector` and `printDevices()` was added.
- **`TC_FONT_*`** defaults now resolve by PostScript/family name; `font.load(TC_FONT_SANS_JA, 24)` works cross-platform, and direct `.ttf` paths still work.
- **Mouse events**: the typed args refactor keeps the old `MouseEventArgs` signatures source-compatible until v1.0.


_Thanks to @funatsufumiya for the tcxLua work._

name: v0.5.4 — Hot Reload polish across macOS / Windows / Linux
body:
This release focuses on making hot reload actually work the same way on every supported OS, plus a couple of build-system polish items uncovered along the way.

## Hot reload (cross-platform)

- **Windows: drawRectRounded rendering white, tweens frozen, no log output from the guest, `getDeltaTime()` stuck at 0** — root cause was inline-function statics getting duplicated across the Host (EXE) and Guest (DLL) under MSVC's per-DLL symbol namespace. `getDefaultContext`, `events`, `tcGetLogger`, and the timer accessors now live in `.cpp` files so both modules share a single instance ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- **All OSes: `Node::addChild()` could crash (mac silently misbehaved)** — `tcHotReloadCreateApp()` used a raw `new`, so `enable_shared_from_this` was never initialized. The hot-reload App is now wrapped in a `std::shared_ptr` with a custom deleter that goes back through the Guest DLL's `destroyApp`. macOS `RelWithDebInfo` was hiding the bug because `-DNDEBUG` no-op'd the assert ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- **Windows / Visual Studio: hot-reload guest rebuild failing** — added `"vs"` to the build-dir search list, read `CMAKE_COMMAND` out of `CMakeCache.txt` so we don't pick up an older PATH cmake that doesn't know the current VS generator, and switched to `CreateProcessA` to tolerate spaces in the cmake path ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- **macOS / Xcode generator: hot reload didn't work** — added `"xcode"` to the build-dir search list, the guest dylib is now located under the multi-config `Debug/Release/...` subdirs, and an explicit `add_dependencies(host guest)` is added on Mac/Linux so IDE-driven host builds pull the guest in ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- **Linux: hot reload crashed after the first reload when using stateful addons (e.g. tcxImGui)** — GCC's default `-fgnu-unique-symbols` marks Meyer's singletons as `STB_GNU_UNIQUE`, which glibc's loader refuses to unload. The Guest is now built with `-fno-gnu-unique` so static locals get unloaded properly on `dlclose()` and each reload starts clean ([#95](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/95)).

## Build system

- macOS / Xcode generator project now uses `cmake -G Xcode -B xcode` directly (same pattern as the Visual Studio generator). This drops the `"xcode"` configurePreset so CMake Tools no longer shows a "Select Configure Preset" quick pick on every workspace open ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- `trusscli` Visual Studio project generation no longer fails when `TRUSSC_DIR` is left to its default ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).
- MSVC build noise (D9025, C4068) suppressed ([#94](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/94)).

## Addons

- **tcxLua**: `LuaModulePreference` API for controlling which standard Lua modules are exposed to scripts ([#93](https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/pull/93), thanks @funatsufumiya).

## Upgrade notes

No API breaks. Existing projects should pick up the fixes after pulling and rebuilding; existing CMake build directories from earlier versions will benefit from a fresh reconfigure.

name: v0.5.3 — miniaudio unification, sokol sync, stroke fixes
body:
Workshop-ready snapshot prepared for the IAMAS class (2026-05-26). Big content release with audio backend consolidation, sokol headers brought up to upstream master, plus a wave of stroke / node / platform fixes.

## Highlights

### Audio — codec consolidation (PR #88)

- `Sound::load()` / `SoundBuffer::load()` now route WAV and MP3 through **miniaudio's `ma_decoder`** (single codepath), and **FLAC** is supported for the first time.
- `SoundBuffer` learned auto-detect by extension + memory-load variants for all formats.
- Removed the standalone `dr_wav.h` / `dr_mp3.h` vendored copies (-14,418 lines).
- New `AudioRegressionTest` app exercises every decoder path against an FFmpeg-generated corpus.

### Sokol — upstream sync (PR #86, #87)

- Brought **sokol_gfx / sokol_app / sokol_gl / sokol_imgui** up to upstream master `082152c` (179 commits worth of changes).
- All 14 TrussC patches preserved via 3-way merge; `TRUSSC_MODIFICATIONS.md` updated.
- Fixed a slipped double-include of `<android/configuration.h>` discovered during the merge.
- Silenced an enum-enum warning in sokol_app via a small TrussC patch.

### Stroke quality (PR #92)

- **`fix(stroke): miter join width preservation`** — the inside vertex of a Miter join used `avgNormal * hw` instead of `miterNormal * hw`, pinching the stroke thinner near joints. Visible on shapes like pentagrams. Both sides now extend to the miter intersection, matching NanoVG / Cairo behavior.
- **`fix(stroke): closed-stroke seam spike`** — `for (i = 0; i <= N) vertex(...)` + `endStroke(true)` produced a NaN normal at the seam and a sharp spike at high stroke weights. Trailing duplicate vertex now dropped within a width-scaled tolerance.

### Input — modifier-key helpers (PR #92)

```cpp
inline bool isShiftPressed();      // KEY_LEFT_SHIFT   || KEY_RIGHT_SHIFT
inline bool isControlPressed();    // KEY_LEFT_CONTROL || KEY_RIGHT_CONTROL
inline bool isAltPressed();        // KEY_LEFT_ALT     || KEY_RIGHT_ALT
inline bool isSuperPressed();      // KEY_LEFT_SUPER   || KEY_RIGHT_SUPER
```

Picked four explicit functions over a `KEY_SHIFT` sentinel + generic `isModifierKeyPressed()` to remove the quiet-failure misuse (`isKeyPressed(KEY_SHIFT)` would silently return false).

### Drawing — new primitives & corrections

- **`drawBezier`** (cubic / quadratic / N-th order) and **`drawCurve`** (Catmull-Rom, chained + closed) (PR #79).
- **`drawArc(x, y, radius, angleBegin, angleEnd)`** with documented fill/stroke asymmetry.
- **`Path::drawStroke()`** for thick-line rendering via StrokeMesh.
- **`fix(graphics): drawRectRounded / drawRectSquircle`** silently dropped corners for negative dimensions (PR #90).
- N-th order Bezier / Catmull-Rom chain length now capped for safety (PR #79).
- `drawCircle/Ellipse/RectRounded/Squircle` pick segment count via shared helper.

### Node system

- **`fix: tighten Node tree mutation safety across dispatch sites`** (PR #91) — children list snapshotted during tree iteration, `processTimers` made reentrancy-safe.
- **`feat(node): moveToFront / moveToBack`** for z-order reordering (PR #82, #85).

### trusscli & platforms

- **`trusscli --version`** + `doctor` version sync check (PR #86 line).
- Addon system: `category` field in `addon.json`, GitHub stars shown in `trusscli addon` list/search.
- **`fix(trusscli): block git arg injection in addon clone`** (PR #79).
- **Hot reload**: dropped `std::system()` in favor of `argv` spawn for safer shell-less invocation.
- **Android**: java sources compiled into APK, `hasCode` templated via `TC_APP_HAS_CODE`.
- **WebGPU**: shadow depth pipeline pinned to `sample_count=1` for compatibility.
- **macOS**: silenced ld duplicate-libraries diamond-dep warning, `stb_image_write` snprintf for deprecation-free SDK build, deprecated AVFoundation calls routed through `NS_INLINE` helpers.
- **captureWindow**: allow CPU read from Metal drawable (issue #56).

### tcxLua (community contributions)

- `Sound` / `PlayingSound` bindings.
- `IVec2` / `IVec3`, equality for vec/quat/Mat3.
- More `Font` method support, fix to `name` method of `XmlNode`/`XmlAttribute`.
- Enum bindings: `StrokeJoin`, `Cursor`, `Direction`, `Orientation`.

### tcxObj

- MSVC 2026 build fix (constexpr distance).

### Docs

- `api-definition.yaml` updated for new curve / arc / modifier-helper / FLAC / moveToFront-Back APIs, with ja / ko translations.
- `REFERENCE.md` regenerated via `docs/scripts/generate-docs.js`.
- AI assistant guide refreshed for new addon system and curve APIs.
- ROADMAP entries: real-time audio stream API, AudioSettings init overload, LoadResult unified loader, INT10_N2 pixel format selection.

## Acknowledgements

Big thanks to **@funatsufumiya** for the steady stream of tcxLua improvements (PRs #73, #75, #76).

name: TrussC v0.5.2
body:
TrussC v0.5.2 focuses on a full curve/Bézier drawing API, Android fixes, and the new addon registry system.

## Highlights

### Curves & Bézier (new)
- `drawBezier()` — cubic (4 points), quadratic (3 points), and N-th order (control polygon)
- `drawCurve()` — Catmull-Rom splines, with chained and closed variants
- `drawArc(x, y, radius, angleBegin, angleEnd)` — radians, counter-clockwise convention
- `Path` curve methods (`bezierTo`, `quadBezierTo`, `curveTo`, `arc()`) are now tolerance-aware (`resolution = -1` follows the current `CurveStyle`)
- `Path::drawStroke()` — thick-line rendering via `StrokeMesh`
- **Adaptive tessellation**: `setCurveTolerance(pixels)` (pixel-error based, accounts for zoom & scale) and `setCurveResolution(n)` (fixed segments). All curved primitives (circle / ellipse / roundedRect / squircle / arc) now share one segment-decision path
- `setCircleResolution()` kept as a deprecated alias (still builds, with a warning)
- Fix: `drawBezier` / `drawCurve` previously ignored fill/stroke mode
- New examples: `curvesExample`, `curveVariationsExample`

### Android
- `setImmersiveMode()` now hides the navigation bar on API 30+ (including Android 16)
- Added `WAKE_LOCK` permission
- Project-local `AndroidManifest.xml` override support

### Addons & trusscli
- `addon.json` spec gains a `category` field; applied to all bundled addons
- Added `addon.json` for bundled `tcxGltf` and `tcxObj`
- Extended `trusscli addon` commands with registry integration

name: v0.5.1 — hot reload polish + cross-platform fixes
body:
Patch release focused on hot reload robustness plus a few community fixes.

## 🔥 Hot reload (#67, #71)

- **Addons now live inside the guest**, not the host. Previous round only fixed include paths — addon symbols were still stripped from the host by dead-code elimination, so dlopen failed on real apps. Each addon's `.a` is now linked directly into the guest via `$<TARGET_FILE:..>`; addon state resets cleanly on each reload.
- Guest static libs built with `POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON` so the Linux `.so` link succeeds.
- Reload re-seeds the new App's window size — fixes UI squished into the top-left after every reload.
- `<TrussC.h>` precompiled on guest. Local test: reload time ~3.9s → ~2.8s.
- The build-time state-check now respects the same platform exclusion as configure-time. `TC_HOT_RELOAD` in source no longer breaks Android / Web / iOS builds.
- Windows guest DLL link error ("unresolved external symbol main") fixed.

## 🌐 Cross-platform

- `setOrientation()` is now cross-platform — previously iOS-only, now Android-aware (#67).
- Fbo vertical flip on OpenGL / GLES backends fixed (#69, #70 — thanks @icq4ever).
- TCScript: io / coroutine / packages on by default; `vec` / `color` / `rect` get explicit `set*` methods (#68 — thanks @funatsufumiya).
- trusscli on Windows: CMD / PowerShell compatibility (#66) and `~/.trussc/config.json` via `%USERPROFILE%` (#65).

## 🧪 CI

- New `examples/tests/HotReloadExample` exercises the host/guest split on macOS / Linux / Windows so hot reload regressions don't slip through (#67).

name: v0.5.0 — trusscli, GPU PBR, hot reload, and a wave of new addons
body:
92 commits since v0.4.4 (2026-04-17). Major reorganization plus several new subsystems that have been brewing for a while.

## ✨ Highlights

- **trusscli**: project generator and CLI tool unified into a single `trusscli` binary, with completion, project copy, and other QoL improvements
- **GPU PBR rendering** with IBL, materials, and a new lighting pipeline
- **Hot reload** (Stage 1) for desktop platforms — guest DLL split that cuts edit-build-see-result loops to seconds
- **Six new addons**: `tcxLua` (with LuaJIT), `tcxObj`, `tcxGltf`, and `tcxImGui` extracted from core
- **Linux video acceleration**: VAAPI / V4L2M2M / DRM / CUDA / VDPAU paths with audio sync and NV12 fast path
- **Platform-detection APIs**: compile-time `Platform::isMacOS()` / `GraphicsBackend::isWebGPU()` / `BuildInfo::dateTime()` family

## 🛠 Build & developer experience

- **trusscli** consolidates project generator + CLI (#34)
- `trusscli cp` for duplicating projects (#50)
- zsh / bash shell completion (#38)
- **tcxImGui extracted** from core into its own addon (#34)
- Hot reload Stage 1 (Linux/macOS/Windows) (#35) + polish (#46)

- Auto-detect Android SDK build-tools / NDK platform versions (#58)
- Console mode + headless guide for Raspberry Pi / SBC (#37)
- `--session x11` end-to-end on Raspberry Pi 5 over SSH (#49)
- WiFi multicast / state permissions for UDP broadcast on Android
- Linux job-parallelism limited by available RAM (prevents SBC OOM)
- TAU literals replace stray PI / 3.14 (#22)

## 🎨 Graphics

- **GPU PBR rendering pipeline** with materials, lights, IBL (#36)
- D3D11 PBR crash + Ninja+MSVC build fixes (#44)
- IBL cubemap Y-flip fix removes seam artifacts (#46)
- Vertex color in lighting calculation (#17)
- Stop tracking auto-generated `*.glsl.h` shader headers

## 🎬 Video

- Linux HW decoding: VAAPI / V4L2M2M / DRM / CUDA / VDPAU (#30)
- AV sync on Linux VideoPlayer (audio-master clock + hard re-sync) (#31)
- HEVC EAGAIN/drain handling (#40)
- `setLoop()` audio reset on Linux (#43)
- GPU NV12 path for HW decoders (#45)
- Linux audio playback (#28)
- HW transfer drop logging + NV12 fast path (#33)
- `isUsingHwAccel` / `getHwAccelName` queries on `VideoPlayerBase` (#26)

## 🧩 New addons

- **tcxLua** — Lua scripting layer via sol2 with bindings for TrussC core, Vec/Color/Rect/Path/Font/Json/Xml/Tween, plus shader `setUniform` overloads (#52, #57, #58, #59, #61)
- **LuaJIT** support inside tcxLua (opt-in via `USE_LUAJIT`) (#61)
- **tcxObj** — OBJ mesh loading with PBR material conversion (#46)
- **tcxGltf** — glTF loading integrated with the PBR pipeline (#36, #46)
- **tcxImGui** extracted from core (#34)

## 🔌 New APIs

- `Platform::isWeb()` / `isMacOS()` / `isMobile()` / `name()` etc.
- `GraphicsBackend::isWebGPU()` / `isWebGL2()` / `isMetal()` / `name()`
- `BuildInfo::date()` / `dateTime()` / `timestamp()` / `year()` etc. (CMake-injected, refresh on reconfigure)

- `setKeepScreenOn()` / `getKeepScreenOn()` to prevent display sleep
- `Tween::delay()` for deferred start and loop pauses (#17)
- `Shader::setUniform(int, vector<Vec3>)` (#51)

## 🔒 Security

- TLS certificate verification required by default for HTTPS
- WebSocket `wss://` requires TLS cert verification by default
- mbedTLS bumped v3.5.0 → v3.6.2 (LTS)
- Auto-load CA trust anchors on first handshake
- `SECURITY.md` added with TLS / font notes

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- `getDeltaTime()` returns actual elapsed time since last update (#15)

## 📚 Docs

name: v0.4.4
body:
## What's New

### Linux
- **VideoPlayer audio playback** — Added audio support to the Linux VideoPlayer using FFmpeg + libswresample. Audio is pre-decoded into a `SoundBuffer` at load time for stable A/V sync. All playback controls (play, stop, pause, resume, seek, volume, speed) now affect both video and audio. (#28, thanks @icq4ever)

## Notes

No breaking changes. Videos without audio tracks still play normally.

Pre-loading the full audio buffer works well for videos up to ~10 minutes. A streaming approach for longer content is left as future work.

name: v0.4.3
body:
## What's New

### macOS
- **Cmd+Q now works** — Added standard application menu (About / Hide / Hide Others / Show All / Quit). `sokol_app` does not install an `NSMenu` by default, so Cmd+Q previously had no effect. The Quit item routes through `sapp_request_quit()` so user code can still intercept via `events().exitRequested`. (#25)

### Tooling
- **projectGenerator on PATH (optional)** — Both the Linux and macOS `buildProjectGenerator_*` scripts now prompt (y/N) at the end to create an optional `/usr/local/bin/projectGenerator` symlink, so the command is available system-wide. Uses `sudo` only when the target directory is not writable. (#25, related to #19)

### Refactoring & Cleanup
- Replaced `PI` / `3.14` literals with `TAU` constants across the codebase (#22)
- Removed duplicate `IVec2` / `IVec3` definitions from `docs/api-definition.yaml` (#18)
- ROADMAP updated: removed implemented items, added new planned features (#22)

## Notes

No breaking changes. Existing projects continue to work without modification.

A larger refactor is being planned in #24 — see that issue for the upcoming unified `trusscli` CLI and the `trussc/` → `core/` folder rename.

name: v0.4.2

name: v0.4.1
body:
## New Features

- **IVec2 / IVec3**: Integer vector types with basic arithmetic, comparison, and conversion to Vec2/Vec3
- **Window Position API**: `getWindowPosition()` / `setWindowPosition()` — native implementation on macOS (NSWindow) and Windows (Win32), stub on Linux/mobile/web
- **Tween delay()**: Chainable `.delay(seconds)` that defers animation start. Delay is re-applied on each loop/yoyo iteration, enabling move-wait-reverse-wait patterns
- **Reusable Release Workflow**: GitHub Actions workflow for building and distributing TrussC apps across macOS/Windows/Linux. Supports optional code signing and notarization. Apps call it via `workflow_call` from their own repos

## Bug Fixes

- **getDeltaTime() fix**: Now returns actual elapsed time since the last update call using `std::chrono`, instead of sokol's smoothed frame duration. Fixes Tween and other time-dependent code running at wrong speed when FPS is changed via `setFps()`
- **getFrameRate()** updated to reflect real update frequency (was always reporting VSync rate regardless of `setFps()` setting)

## Examples

- **windowPositionExample**: New example in `examples/windowing/` demonstrating `getWindowPosition()` / `setWindowPosition()` with arrow key controls

## Documentation

- IVec2, IVec3, getWindowPosition, setWindowPosition added to `api-definition.yaml`

name: v0.4.0 — Android, iOS & Raspberry Pi Support (Beta)
body:
## What's New

### Mobile Platform Support (Beta)
- **Android** — GLES3 backend, auto APK packaging, NDK sensor API (accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, proximity, battery, volume, brightness), immersive mode, logcat integration
- **iOS** — Metal backend, Xcode project generation, CoreMotion sensors, camera, video player, file dialogs, automatic code signing
- **Raspberry Pi** — Improved detection and GLES3 backend

### Touch Events
- New multi-touch API: `touchPressed()` / `touchMoved()` / `touchReleased()` with `TouchEventArgs` (up to 8 simultaneous touch points)
- `setTouchAsMouse(true/false)` — maps first touch to mouse events (default ON on Android/iOS, OFF elsewhere)
- `TouchEventArgs.cancelled` flag for system interruptions

### Build System
- Project Generator: "Cross-compile targets" collapsible UI for Android/iOS/Web
- Android: `cmake --preset android` builds .so + APK automatically
- iOS: `cmake --preset ios` generates Xcode project
- WebGL/WebGPU backend switch via `TC_WEB_BACKEND`
- Web builds default to `MinSizeRel` for smaller WASM output
- CI: Android ARM64 build job with AllFeaturesExample

### System API
- `setImmersiveMode()` / `getImmersiveMode()` — hide system UI (Android: status bar, others: no-op)
- `getAccelerometer()`, `getGyroscope()`, `getCompassHeading()`, `getDeviceOrientation()`, `isProximityClose()`
- `getBatteryLevel()`, `isBatteryCharging()`
- `getSystemVolume()` / `setSystemVolume()`, `getSystemBrightness()` / `setSystemBrightness()`
- `getThermalState()` / `getThermalTemperature()`
- `getLocation()` (iOS only, Android stub)

### Other
- `buildAppDescriptor<T>()` — public API for advanced entry point customization
- Android system font paths (`/system/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf`)
- sokol_app.h: real DPI scaling on Android via `AConfiguration_getDensity()`
- Logger: dedicated Android logcat listener (`__android_log_write`)
- miniaudio rationale documented in source

## Beta Notice

> **Android, iOS, and Raspberry Pi support is in beta.**
> These platforms have not been extensively tested across a wide range of devices. Some features may not work as expected, and there are known limitations:
>
> - **Android**: File dialogs, AAC audio decoding, video playback/capture, and GPS are not yet implemented (stubs). Screen brightness reports gamma-corrected values.
> - **iOS**: First launch may show a black screen for up to 30 seconds. GPS requires additional setup.
> - **Raspberry Pi**: Limited testing on newer models only.
>
> If you encounter issues, please report them at https://github.com/TrussC-org/TrussC/issues

name: v0.3.2
body:
## v0.3.2

### Bug Fixes
- **FullscreenShader / LutShader black screen fix** — `FullscreenShader::draw()` and `LutShader::drawSubsection()` called `sg_draw()` directly, but the swapchain pass is deferred to `present()`. Added `ensureSwapchainPass()` which starts the pass on demand (idempotent, safe inside FBO pass). This also enables future GPGPU ping-pong workflows using FBO + shader. (#4)

### Improvements
- **Linux dependency install script** — Added `install_dependencies_linux.sh` as a single source of truth for Linux package dependencies. CI and local builds now share the same script. (#3)

### sokol_gl buffer stability
- Retire-list for GPU buffer grow now uses a unified path across all platforms (removed `#ifdef SOKOL_METAL` branching). Verified with 10 example apps on macOS.

name: v0.3.1
body:
## Windows Stability

- **D3D11 WARP software fallback** — Automatically falls back to software rendering when hardware D3D11 device creation fails (e.g., GitHub Actions runners, VMs without GPU)
- **Progressive D3D11 fallback** — Step-by-step degradation: full features → no video support → debug layer disabled
- **Window foreground on startup** — App window now correctly comes to foreground on launch
- **VideoPlayer path resolution** — Relative paths now resolve correctly via `getDataPath()`
- **VS environment detection in CLI** — ProjectGenerator CLI mode now properly detects Visual Studio via vswhere

## macOS

- **Build without full Xcode** — Projects now build with Xcode Command Line Tools only. The `.icon` folder (macOS Tahoe) is gracefully skipped when full Xcode is not installed
- **Exclude .mm/.m files on non-Apple** — Objective-C/C++ sources are no longer included in GLOB on Windows/Linux

## Networking / TLS

- **Unified curl TLS backend** — macOS uses system curl, Windows uses mbedTLS with bundled CA certificates
- **mbedTLS as primary SSL backend** — Replaced Schannel with mbedTLS on Windows for consistent TLS behavior
- **Offline mbedTLS fallback** — Falls back to Schannel when mbedTLS FetchContent fails (offline builds)
- **HTTP PUT support** — Added PUT method to the HTTP client

## CI Improvements

- Increased build timeout to 120 minutes for full builds
- Fixed generator mismatch (Ninja vs VS) caused by stale build cache
- Added `libcurl4-openssl-dev` to Linux CI dependencies
- Fixed `build_all.py` generator conflict on Windows

**20 commits** since v0.3.0

name: v0.3.0
body:
## Breaking Changes

- **MCP transport: stdio → HTTP** — MCP communication now uses HTTP instead of stdio. Existing MCP integrations need to update their transport layer.
- **`map()` renamed to `remap()`** — To avoid collision with `std::map`. Find-and-replace in your code.
- **Color hue normalized to 0–1** — HSB/HSL hue values are now 0.0–1.0 instead of 0–360.
- **`sokol_gl.h` renamed to `sokol_gl_tc.h`** — Internal change, but may affect custom build setups.

## New Features

### GPU & Rendering
- 10-bit color output (RGB10A2) on Metal and D3D11
- Float pixel format (F32) and RGBA32F texture support
- Mipmap support for Texture
- Porter-Duff over blending for FBO with premultiplied compositing
- Shared sgl_context/pipelines across all FBO instances (major resource savings)
- Auto-resize sokol_gl vertex buffer on overflow
- Deferred swapchain pass start to eliminate FBO flickering
- 3D `drawLine` (6-float) and `beginLines`/`endLines` batch API

### Node System
- `Node::destroy()` for safe deferred removal from scene graph
- `resetStyle` before each Node draw for style isolation
- `onActiveChanged`/`onVisibleChanged` callbacks
- Clipping-aware hit test in RectNode
- `getChildren()` returns copy to prevent iterator invalidation
- `localToGlobal`/`globalToLocal` migrated to Vec3 API

### Input & Cursor
- Cursor API: `setCursor`, `hideCursor`, `showCursor`, `bindCursorImage` (system + custom image)

### Sound & Media
- `VideoPlayer::extractFrame()` static method for thumbnail extraction
- Platform-specific image loader fallback (HEIC/HEIF via macOS ImageIO)

### AI / MCP
- ImGui MCP tools — auto-expose ImGui widgets via MCP
- Events system: `events().notify()` for all CoreEvents

### Addons
- **tcxCurl** — New official addon with auto-fetch libcurl on Windows via FetchContent
- `setTimeout()` for configurable request timeout
- Verbose mode for curl debug logging

### Other
- `isKeyPressed()` for polling keyboard state
- `setBitmapLineHeight`/`getBitmapLineHeight` for configurable newline spacing
- `Pixels::clone()` for deep copy
- `local.cmake` support for project-specific CMake config
- Configurable up axis for EasyCam (Y-up/Z-up)

## Bug Fixes

- D3D11 GPU buffer/texture crashes and font DPI handling
- `runApp` now manages App as `shared_ptr`
- Multi-line text alignment in `Font::drawString`
- Blend pipeline restore after texture/font rendering
- `assert` when `addChild`/`insertChild` called in constructor
- Rotation matrix transpose for `rotate(Quaternion)` in sokol_gl
- RGB10A2 screenshot capture on Mac/Win
- Windows: TLS 1.3 forced to avoid Schannel timeout, curl keepalive improvements
- Windows: auto-detect VS environment in projectGenerator build script
- sokol pipeline pool increased from 64 to 256
- sokol image/view/sampler pool increased to 10000

## Internal

- sokol headers updated to upstream `4838409` (2026-02-23)
- sokol_gl forked for multi-FBO rendering with auto-grow buffers
- FBO sgl context buffer sizes matched to main context

**65 commits** since v0.2.4

### CMake Build System Improvements

- **Simplified CMakeLists.txt** - Template is now a simple copy, all customization in CMakePresets.json
- **TRUSSC_DIR strategy**: Examples use relative path fallback, user projects use absolute path
- Windows: Auto-detect MSVC environment (INCLUDE/LIB/PATH) and Ninja path
- Removed 46 redundant CMakePresets.json files from examples (-2668 lines)

### Windows Support
- Hide console window on Windows GUI apps
- Use VS-bundled CMake/Ninja via vcvarsall.bat
- Proper IntelliSense support with compile_commands.json

### projectGenerator Improvements
- Refactored into VsDetector, IdeHelper, ProjectGenerator modules
- CMake configure runs automatically for VSCode/Cursor IntelliSense
- IDE dropdown shows detected VS version name

### Other Features
- `noWindowMode` (headless) support for non-GUI applications
- Log API renamed: `tcLogNotice` → `logNotice`, `tcLogWarning` → `logWarning`, etc.

### Refactoring
- Encapsulated Node transform, TcpServerClient, GlyphInfo members
- RectNode button state encapsulation

### Documentation
- Added Discord link
- Comprehensive texture mapping documentation in meshTextureExample
- Fixed outdated Log API references

name: TrussC v0.1.0 - Initial Release
body:
# TrussC v0.1.0 - Initial Release

TrussC is a lightweight creative coding framework based on sokol. Developed by tettou771, a big fan of openFrameworks.
sokolベースの軽量クリエイティブコーディングフレームワークです。openFrameworksが大好きなtettou771が開発しています。

---

### Motivation

**開発の動機**

I created this because I wanted to run graphics more natively than just OpenGL, and I had faced licensing issues in my professional work (since some internal dependencies of oF are GPL). I had long wanted to solve these problems. But to be honest, maybe I simply yearned to be a framework creator.

I am not actually an engineer capable of building a framework from scratch. However, by standing on the shoulders of the amazing library "sokol," I was able to build the framework with the specifications I had dreamed of. Sokol wraps the complex GPU system—which I could never fully understand on my own—with just the right amount of abstraction, allowing me to build a structure that fits my own preferences (though it is still a work in progress). I am deeply grateful for being allowed to use it under such a generous license.

OpenGLではなくもっとネイティブに動かしたいということや、ライセンス問題（oFは内部依存ライブラリの一部にGPLがある）で仕事で困ったことがあり、それを解決したいとずっと思っていたので作成しました。でも本当は、単にフレームワークの制作者に憧れていたからかもしれません。

僕自身は、本当はフレームワークをゼロから作れるほどのエンジニアではないのですが、sokolという素晴らしいライブラリの上に乗ることで夢見ていた仕様のフレームワークを作ることができました。本来はとても理解できないほど複雑なGPUのシステムをちょうどいい薄さでラップしていただいていることで、自分好みの構造を組み立てていくことができそうです（まだ途中です）。寛大なライセンスのもと使用させていただき感謝しています。

### Made with AI

**AIと一緒に作りました**

While I haven't fully solidified how I should approach AI in coding yet, I feel hesitant to even mention it. However, I thought it might be insincere to hide my stance on AI, so I am writing this.

I have borrowed a lot of power from AI, especially **Claude Code**. In fact, the creation of the trussc.org website was almost entirely "vibe coding." However, the core of TrussC is code that we built together.

I have been using oF for nearly 10 years. I designed the structure of TrussC by exploring ways to seamlessly fuse the parts I loved about oF with the libraries I had reluctantly grown myself to cover its inconveniences.

Today, many people may criticize code written with AI. Some say that only code written by one's own hands belongs to them, and everything else is borrowed. I understand that perspective. However, even with outsourced productions, if the direction is deep and precise enough, it is undoubtedly considered the creator's own work.

I respect engineers who can code everything with their own hands. On the other hand, I am proud to call TrussC my own creation because I designed it in detail through the layer of "direction." This is my current thought.

まだコーディングにおいてAIとの向き合い方は固まっていない中で、僕自身も言及すること自体に慎重になってしまいます。でもAIに対するスタンスを隠すのも不誠実かもしれないと思い、この文章を書いています。

AI、特にClaude Codeの力も沢山借りています。実はtrussc.orgのサイト制作はほぼvibe codingです。でも、TrussCの中身は共に作り上げたコードです。
oFをかれこれ10年近く使っていますが、oFの好きだったところと、不便だったので仕方なく自分で育てていたライブラリ群、それらをうまく融合させた実装がないか模索して設計してTrussCの構造を考えました。

今はAIと一緒に書いたコードについて非難する人も多いかもしれません。自分の手で書いたコードこそが自分のもの、それ以外は借り物だと言う人もいると思います。確かに、その考えも理解できます。しかし仮に外注して作った制作物でも、十分深くディレクションしたものはやはり本人の制作物とみなされることも事実でしょう。

僕は、全てを自分の手でコーディングできるエンジニアを尊敬しています。一方で、TrussCはディレクションというレイヤーで詳細に設計したことをもって、胸を張って自分の制作物だと思っています。これが、現時点での僕の考えです。

---

TrussC is still in its infancy. It is like a child following in the footsteps of the many great creative coding frameworks designed by my predecessors.
I hope you will watch over its growth warmly.

TrussCはまだ未熟ですが、先輩方が設計された数々のクリエイティブコーディングフレームワークの背中を追いかける子供のような存在です。
どうか、暖かく見守っていただけると幸いです。

---

## Supported Platforms

* **macOS** (Metal)
* **Windows** (D3D11)
* **Web** (WebGPU via Emscripten)
* **Linux** (OpenGL)

## Key Features

### Graphics

* Basic primitives, Images, Fonts (Bitmap/TrueType)
* Path, Mesh, StrokeMesh
* Clipping, Blend modes
* FBO (Frame Buffer Object), Shaders, Textures

### 3D

* 3D Primitives, Transforms
* EasyCam (Mouse-controlled camera)
* Node / RectNode system
* Lighting, Materials

### Sound & Video

* SoundPlayer, Microphone input
* ChipSound (Procedural audio generation)
* VideoPlayer (FFmpeg), VideoGrabber (Webcam)

### Others

* TCP/UDP Communication
* Event System
* Dear ImGui Integration
* Timer, Serial communication, File dialogs
* JSON/XML support, Clipboard access

### Tools

* **projectGenerator** (GUI) - Supports VSCode, Cursor, Xcode, and Visual Studio.

## Notes

* **First Release:** As this is the initial release (v0.1.0), the API is subject to frequent changes.
* **WebGPU:** Due to strict constraints, some features are currently unimplemented in the WebGPU version.
